incidents.name: Storage issues in us-east-1 and eu-central-1

incident_updates.body: We will be conducting maintenance to address storage service improvements between 0800 and 0900 UTC on 5 November 2026. There may be an interruption of storage services in us-east-1 at some point during that window. The impact will be of a short duration and limited to us-east-1.

The cause of the issue has been identified as directly related to load. We will be doing maintenance on our platform to address this issue. As of now, storage response has returned to normal. We will continue to monitor the environment.

We are still investigating increased error rates for storage requests, and have expanded the investigation to eu-central-1 as well.

The team has identified higher-than-usual load in some areas of the storage infrastructure and is currently working on remediation options.
We have identified some customers in us-east-1 are experiencing 5XX errors when interacting with our Storage components. We are investigating.

We will be carrying out a scheduled maintenance window to perform internal platform improvements and upgrades.

Maintenance Window:

• Start time: 03:00 UTC on July 2, 2026

• End time: 04:00 UTC on July 2, 2026

Impact:

• Various platform operations will be delayed during this window

• These may include project creation and initial configuration/setup

• All affected operations will be rescheduled at the end of the window to ensure no operation is dropped
